schedule_discrepancies: Invoice 1510202633 has a EUR 2,192.75 PDF face total; the schedule records EUR 1,192.75 after a EUR 1,000 retainer credit.
The schedule transposes the PDF face amounts of invoices 1510207265 and 1510207279.
The schedule dates for invoices 1510207267, 1510207309, 1510212237 and 1710215245 conflict with the PDF transaction dates.
Six predecessor invoices originally addressed to LPB were reissued to Aweswell at identical values; no cancellation/credit-note chain is included in the reviewed pack.
Invoice 1810108702 labels EUR 34,237.50 as a 67.15% discount on EUR 104,237.50; it is 32.85%, while 67.15% is the retained/billed proportion before disbursements.

Invoice 1810219093 leaves EUR 67,492.50 after its EUR 30,000 partial bill is deducted from EUR 97,492.50 accrued; the 2019 schedule lists EUR 61,404.95 of 2018 work to be invoiced, leaving EUR 6,087.55 to explain as discount, write-off, reallocation or error.
